convention: Full-slate party shares, as scripts/score-may-2026-like-for-like.mjs: every candidate's votes summed by party over all votes cast in the ward. "Labour and Co-operative Party" counts as Labour, as in local-and-mayor.merged.json. pooled keeps Reform UK, Labour, Conservative, Liberal Democrats and Green Party and puts every other party and independent in Others.

methods.same_ward: The ward's own last ordinary result on the same boundaries (same ONS code). For an all-out council it must come from the council's last ordinary poll or later, so an older result is never passed off as current.
methods.renamed: An explicit old-to-new mapping from a source. None found in this cut.
methods.notional: Old wards' results carried to the new ward by the 2021 LSOAs they share (ONS best-fit lookups; a centroid best-fit for May 2026 wards), weights kept. Validated below.
methods.none: No baseline. The note says why.

by_elections: Kept out of every baseline. last_by_election is the most recent principal-council by-election in the ward on its current boundaries, from the Democracy Club file (to April 2026) and data/history/byelection-appends.json (since May 2026).
fallback_2019: Context only, never a baseline: where a ward has no baseline, its 2 May 2019 result (LEAP) on the same code, or carried to it by LSOAs. Eight years old by polling day.

notional_validation.method: Scored on real boundary changes: the earlier year's results carried to the later year's new wards by shared 2021 LSOAs, against the new wards' actual results. MAE is the mean absolute error over six pooled groups (Reform UK, Labour, Conservative, Liberal Democrats, Green Party, Others), in share points from 0 to 1. Swing-adjusted adds the council's actual change between the two years first.
